reminders: 1. Contract-First: Define Rust IPC structs & TypeScript interfaces before logic.
2. TDD: Write failing tests in src/**/__tests__/*.test.ts or #[test] in Rust BEFORE writing code.
3. Micro-Validation: Run `python .agents/scripts/verify_shift_left.py --changed` after every file edit.
4. PrimeVue Foundation: No raw HTML <button>/<input>/<select>; use PrimeVue with v-tooltip.

banned_imports.suggestion: Import capabilities via `@/services/nativeService` or specialized domain services instead.

banned_patterns.suggestion: Handle errors explicitly with `?` or `match` / `if let` returning Result<T, E>.

banned_patterns.suggestion: Handle recoverable errors explicitly or log diagnostic failure via Result<T, E>.
